description: Figure 2 presents a pie chart showing the original distribution of emotion categories in the IEMOCAP dataset, with proportions expressed as percentages of the total number of utterances. The chart contains five slices (five emotion categories), each represented by a distinct color, and the approximate percentages are displayed directly on or near the slices. A legend is included to map each color to its corresponding emotion label. No slice appears exploded or otherwise visually emphasized, and the slices appear arranged around the circle without an explicitly indicated ordering scheme beyond their placement.
